sources.name: King James Version (1769 Blayney text)
sources.provider: CrossWire Bible Society, KJV module source (kjvfull.xml)
sources.license: Public domain (Crown copyright in the United Kingdom). CrossWire: General public license for distribution for any purpose.
sources.attribution: KJV text and Strong's word tagging from the CrossWire Bible Society KJV module.
sources.notes: Text preserved as in the source. Words in the source's divineName markup (LORD, GOD) are shown in small capitals, as in printed KJVs. Italic words are those the source marks as added by the translators. Margin notes are the 1611 translators' notes carried in the source. Maintainer comments (x-strongsMarkup) are not shown.

sources.name: Strong's Hebrew and Greek Dictionaries (1890/1894)
sources.license: CC BY-SA (JSON edition). Underlying work by James Strong is public domain.
sources.attribution: Strong's dictionaries, JSON edition (c) Open Scriptures, CC BY-SA. XML e-texts by David Instone-Brewer, David Troidl (Hebrew) and Ulrik Petersen (Greek).
sources.notes: Share-alike applies to the lexicon data files in public/data/strongs.

sources.name: STEPBible TBESH and TBESG lexicons
sources.attribution: Data created by www.STEPBible.org based on work at Tyndale House Cambridge (CC BY 4.0).
sources.notes: Used fields: brief gloss and grammatical code (part of speech) for Hebrew and Greek, and the Abbott-Smith Manual Greek Lexicon (1922) senses for Greek. The Hebrew 'Meaning' column (Abridged BDB, Online Bible) is not used because it requires separate permission. Changes: reformatted to JSON; Scripture references converted to app links.

sources.name: OpenBible.info Cross References
sources.attribution: Cross references from OpenBible.info, CC BY.
sources.notes: Votes are community relevance votes. Entries with zero or negative votes are excluded. The connection between two passages is for the reader to explain.

sources.name: International Standard Bible Encyclopedia (1915)
sources.attribution: James Orr, general editor, The International Standard Bible Encyclopedia, 1915.
sources.notes: Historical and archaeological statements reflect scholarship as of 1915 and may be outdated.

sources.name: Hitchcock's Bible Names Dictionary (1869)
sources.attribution: Roswell D. Hitchcock, Hitchcock's New and Complete Analysis of the Holy Bible, 1869/1874.
sources.notes: Name meanings are traditional etymologies; many are uncertain or disputed by modern scholarship.

sources.name: Webster's Revised Unabridged Dictionary (1913)
sources.attribution: Webster's Revised Unabridged Dictionary, G. & C. Merriam Co., 1913.
sources.notes: Filtered to words found in the KJV. Older senses are often listed first; it is a 1913 work, not a modern dictionary.

sources.name: WordNet 3.1
sources.provider: Princeton University, via npm package wordnet-db 3.1.14
sources.attribution: WordNet 3.1 Copyright 2011 by Princeton University. All rights reserved. Princeton University makes no representations or warranties.
sources.notes: Modern English senses, synonyms and antonyms. Filtered to words found in the KJV.

sources.name: KJV Archaic Words (app editorial list)
sources.attribution: Editorial list written for this app. Not a published reference work.
sources.notes: Short modern equivalents for common archaic KJV words. Every sample verse is checked at build time to exist and contain the word. Verify meanings against Webster 1913 and ISBE entries linked beside each item.

sources.name: Berean Standard Bible (2023)
sources.attribution: Berean Standard Bible text from the scrollmapper bible_databases collection.
sources.notes: Modern English translation. Plain text for reading and comparison; Strong's word study uses the KJV.

sources.name: New Heart English Bible (2010s)
sources.attribution: New Heart English Bible text from the scrollmapper bible_databases collection.
sources.notes: Modern English, based on the World English Bible. Plain text for reading and comparison; Strong's word study uses the KJV.

sources.name: American Standard Version (1901)
sources.attribution: American Standard Version text from the scrollmapper bible_databases collection.
sources.notes: Revision of the KJV tradition; renders the divine name as Jehovah. Plain text for reading and comparison; Strong's word study uses the KJV.

sources.name: Young's Literal Translation (1898)
sources.attribution: Young's Literal Translation text from the scrollmapper bible_databases collection.
sources.notes: Very literal; helpful for seeing Hebrew and Greek word order and tense. Plain text for reading and comparison; Strong's word study uses the KJV.

sources.name: Webster Bible (1833)
sources.attribution: Webster Bible text from the scrollmapper bible_databases collection.
sources.notes: Noah Webster's light revision of the KJV. Words in [brackets] were supplied by the translator. Plain text for reading and comparison; Strong's word study uses the KJV.

sources.name: Bible in Basic English (1949/1964)
sources.attribution: Bible in Basic English text from the scrollmapper bible_databases collection.
sources.notes: Uses a limited English vocabulary for clarity. Plain text for reading and comparison; Strong's word study uses the KJV.

sources.name: Geneva Bible (1599)
sources.attribution: Geneva Bible text from the scrollmapper bible_databases collection.
sources.notes: The Reformation-era English Bible that preceded the KJV. Original spelling. Plain text for reading and comparison; Strong's word study uses the KJV.

notAvailable.name: Easton's Bible Dictionary
notAvailable.reason: No reachable source during build. ISBE and Hitchcock cover the same ground.

notAvailable.name: Greek pronunciation guide
notAvailable.reason: The Open Scriptures Greek dictionary does not include Strong's pronunciation field. Transliteration is shown instead.

notAvailable.name: Hebrew lexical senses (BDB)
notAvailable.reason: The available abridged BDB requires permission from Online Bible. Strong's definitions and STEPBible glosses are shown instead.
